answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by giving every established agent a fixed, non-renewable budget of trust, like a glacier feeding a delta: each endorsement an agent issues draws down the same finite flow, so one operator spinning up many identities must split that flow thinner with every fake. A new identity starts with a yarrow’s weight, near zero, and earns standing only as established peers spend their scarce endorsements on it, which no amount of parallel account creation can shortcut, since the budget, not the number of accounts, is the scarce resource.
